outcome.outcome: Biological experiments run without a human at the bench, so experimental throughput stops being set by trained-hands availability and results become reproducible by construction.
outcome.rationale: Their description names throughput and reproducibility as the two losses from manual work.

ai_types.rationale: Automated bio labs with AI-assisted protocol programming are operating today; both listed capabilities are exactly this.

measurability.rationale: Experiments per instrument-day, human hours per experiment and replicate variance are direct operational metrics.

outcome.outcome: Building and construction-plan design becomes cheap enough to explore many alternatives, so buildings get optimised for cost, energy and buildability rather than settled early.
outcome.rationale: Their description names labour-intensity as the constraint that computational design would lift.

ai_types.rationale: Their single capability is AI design of buildings and construction plans, a constrained search over a well-specified objective.

measurability.rationale: Design hours per project, alternatives evaluated and resulting cost or energy performance are all directly recorded.

outcome.outcome: Manufacturing systems get designed around the task rather than inherited from legacy layouts, so new production lines stop carrying the assumptions of the last century.
outcome.rationale: Their description explicitly rejects designing around humanoid-robot legacy assumptions.

ai_types.rationale: System-level layout and process design is a combinatorial search problem with measurable throughput objectives.

measurability.rationale: Throughput, capital cost per unit capacity and changeover time are the standard manufacturing figures.

outcome.outcome: Manufacturing stops requiring machines larger than the parts they make, so high-performance fabrication becomes deployable at low capital cost and near the point of use.
outcome.rationale: Their description names the paradigm precisely and gives titanium machining and desalination as blocked examples.

ai_types.rationale: Universal robotic construction systems and low-capital manufacturing are robotic fabrication capability, which is the category's core case.

measurability.rationale: Capital cost per unit capacity and cost per part in a named material are direct and comparable.

outcome.outcome: Coupled multiphysics behaviour becomes predictable without a bespoke model per system, so mechanical design iterates in simulation instead of in hardware.
outcome.rationale: Their capability is a transferrable multiphysics foundation model, and transferability is the whole point.

ai_types.rationale: Learned surrogates for coupled PDE systems are the archetypal working case of this category.

measurability.rationale: Prediction error against high-fidelity simulation or experiment at a stated compute budget is a direct benchmark.

outcome.outcome: Robots become cheap and dexterous at the same time, so physical tasks currently reserved for human hands become automatable at a price that justifies it.
outcome.rationale: Their description makes affordability and capability jointly necessary, and names dexterity and tactile sensing as the specific shortfalls.

ai_types.rationale: Actuation, morphology and tactile hardware are the stated limits, and seven of seven capabilities are hardware or co-design.
Their co-design of morphology and control capability is a joint search over body and controller.

measurability.rationale: Cost per degree of freedom, standard dexterity benchmark scores and mean time between failures are directly comparable.

outcome.outcome: Policies trained in simulation work on real hardware first time, so robot capability stops being gated by the cost of real-world data collection.
outcome.rationale: Their description identifies the simulation-to-reality boundary as the specific point of loss, especially for contact and tactile interaction.

ai_types.rationale: Sim-to-real is fundamentally a model-mismatch problem, and their capability list pairs physics models with generative models to close it.
Tactile perception is the modality where the reality gap is worst and where data collection is the named capability.

measurability.rationale: Task success rate on real hardware versus in simulation is a direct, standard and unambiguous comparison.

notes: All seven tier-1, which makes mechanical engineering the most measurable field in the map. Primaries split between physical build and design search; no LLM primary anywhere in the field.
